# Jubilees Chapter 34 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 34:2 — "highlands" vs. "hill country" (Shechem)

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "highlands of Shechem" | Literal rendering of the Ge'ez geographic term |
| LOGOS | "hill country of Shechem" | Standard geographic English for hilly terrain |
| PNEUMA | "highlands of Shechem" | Same as EMET |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS "hill country" — consistent with standard English geographic terminology for this region used throughout the project.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 34:8 — "coat" vs. "robe"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "coat" | Traditional; follows KJV |
| LOGOS | "robe" | More accurate for the Ge'ez ketonet; consistent with ch.37 project convention |
| PNEUMA | "coat" | Traditional rendering |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS "robe." Per project convention from Genesis 37 notes: ketonet passim is rendered "robe" throughout. Consistency with the Genesis translation requires this.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 34:12 — Isaac's death speech

All three translators agreed on the substance; minor differences in register only. No significant disagreement.

**Status:** No major disagreement noted.

---
